items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Tom Kubis. I don’t know if you know him. He’s a young guy. He teaches at Golden West College, a real genius. Great composer.

ctx.x: Who writes most of your charts?
Tom Kubis. I don’t know if you know him. He’s a young guy. He teaches at Golden West College, a real genius. Great composer.
Is the live jazz scene healthy around here or not?
